Numeric values the client fills in at runtime ({f:helpstat_N}, {d:prefix_bonus}, {d:suffix_bonus}) are recorded as null with status UNRESOLVED; they are NOT filled in from previous years.

structure.selection_note: For each role the entrant chooses a TEAM, not an individual player. Confirmed by DOTA_FantasyCraft_Tutorial2026_ViewTablet_Body: 'For each role, you choose a team instead of individual players. For core and support roles, you score points for both players on the team.' The announcement states the same: 'both supports from one team, the safelaner and offlaner from one team, and then your favorite midlaner.'
structure.team_change: free, via the 'Choose Team' button on the War Banner, until the period locks

periods.not_daily: Fantasy is NOT a daily game in TI2026. There are exactly two periods, each covering a whole stage.
periods.carryover: The roster carries over from period to period; crafting improvements persist (DOTA_FantasyCraft_Tutorial_Locked_Body).
periods.unlock: A period unlocks once matches begin for the preceding period.
periods.upgrade: The roster is eligible for an upgrade at the beginning of every period.

scoring_pipeline.verbatim: Once matches for a period begin, a snapshot of your roster is saved and used for scoring. For each role, each player's score is calculated individually in every game they participate in. Players receive points only for the stats present on their War Banner, amplified if any of the conditions of your coach Titles are met. We then average the score of all players for a role and use that to decide the final score for a game. The top two scoring games within a series are used to get the role's final score for the match. If a role participates in more than one series in a period, the best scoring series will be used.

steps.rule: sum over the emblems on the role's War Banner of (base stat points x quality multiplier x trait multipliers), then amplified by the coach Titles whose conditions the game satisfies
arithmetic mean of the scores of the role's players (2 for core, 1 for mid, 2 for support)
the top two scoring games within the series
steps.aggregation_note: The string says the top two games 'are used'; it does not say whether they are summed or averaged. This changes the level, not the ranking, when every series has at least two games, but it changes the ranking when a series ends 2-0 versus 2-1. Confirm in client.

steps.rule: the BEST scoring series, not the sum over series

symbolic_formula.player_game: P(p,g,r) = CoachApply(sum over banner emblems e of RawStat(p,g,stat_e) * BaseCoefficient(stat_e) * EmblemMultiplier(e, banner))
symbolic_formula.role_game: R(g,r) = arithmetic mean of P(p,g,r) over the 2 core players, 1 mid player, or 2 support players selected through the role's team
symbolic_formula.role_period: T(period,r) = max over eligible series of S(series,r)
symbolic_formula.roster_period: F(period) = sum over core, mid, support of T(period,r)
unknown_operators: BaseCoefficient values and the special Deaths and Teamfight Participation transforms
AggregateTopTwo is not identified as sum or average
CoachApply when both the prefix and suffix conditions trigger
the exact composition order of quality and multiple interacting or adjacent trait bonuses

unresolved_semantics.question: Are the top two games within a series summed or averaged?
unresolved_semantics.why_it_matters: It changes the ranking between a team that closes a series 2-0 and one that wins 2-1, and it changes how a Bo3 that goes the distance compares with one that does not.

unresolved_semantics.question: Does the Deaths stat floor at zero, or may it go negative past ten deaths?
unresolved_semantics.why_it_matters: With a 1950 credit and a 195 debit, the eleventh death either costs nothing or costs 195 against the rest of the banner. That is the difference between Deaths being a safe floor and being a live risk on a support banner.

unresolved_semantics.question: What function of participation reaches the 2124 maximum?
unresolved_semantics.why_it_matters: Knowing the cap is not knowing the curve. Linear in participation fraction, thresholded, or something else gives materially different expected values for the same player.
unresolved_semantics.note: The shipped string says only 'Max {f:helpstat_6} points for participating in team fights'.

unresolved_semantics.question: Which actions count as 'a rune bottled or taken'?
unresolved_semantics.why_it_matters: Water runes, wisdom runes, bounty runes and bottling versus picking up may or may not each count, and OpenDota's rune_pickups is a different definition until proven otherwise.

unresolved_semantics.question: Which series in a period are eligible draws, and what happens to a role whose team plays no series in the period?
unresolved_semantics.why_it_matters: It sets the number of extreme-value draws, which is the whole exposure term.

scoring_pipeline.modelling_consequence: Because the period score keeps only the best series, a role's expected period score is an EXTREME-VALUE statistic (a maximum over the series a team plays), not a sum over maps. More series still helps, but through additional draws from the distribution rather than through accumulation. Any model that multiplies expected maps by expected points per map is the wrong estimator for this ruleset. This conclusion is DIRECTIONALLY held, not frozen: it follows from the 'best scoring series will be used' wording, but the exact estimator cannot be fixed until top_two_aggregation and best_series_eligibility are closed. The final model must keep four levels distinct: the per-game score distribution, the top-two-within-series aggregation, the best-series-within-period maximum, and the number of eligible series as the count of extreme-value draws.

confirmed.adjacency_note: Some traits act on adjacent emblems, so the ORDER of emblems on a War Banner is part of the decision.

unresolved.note: Neither the emblem count nor the per-role red/green/blue split appears in any shipped file. Both are required before any optimisation is meaningful.

quality_tiers.note: Higher tiers are rarer when crafting.

list.name: Incorruptible
list.effect: Emblems with quality lower than Tier III are treated as having Tier III quality.

list.name: Benevolent
list.effect: Provides a 20% bonus to the stat value of adjacent emblems.

list.name: Vampiric
list.effect: Increases the stat value of this emblem by 50%, but lowers the stat value of adjacent emblems by 10%.

list.name: Unique
list.effect: +30% to the stat bonus if this is the only Unique emblem on the War Banner.

list.name: Friendly
list.effect: +50% to the stat bonus if there are at least 3 Friendly emblems on the War Banner.

list.name: Fractal
list.effect: +60% to the stat bonus if all emblem qualities on the War Banner are different.

roll_tokens.confirmed: Three unique roll options are available at any time, identical across War Banners. Each roll costs one token, applies only to the currently selected War Banner, and replaces all available roll options. Operations include: reroll stat, reroll quality, increase quality, reroll trait, reroll prefix/suffix, choose prefix/suffix, change team, and randomly increase one or two qualities.
roll_tokens.unresolved: The token budget (initial grant, per-period grant, any purchase route) is not in any shipped file. Without it the crafting problem has no budget constraint and cannot be optimised.

candidate_reading.text_as_read: two reward-unlock rows reading approximately '+40 Group Stage crafting rerolls' and '+30 The International fantasy crafting reroll tokens'
candidate_reading.caveat: Read by the assistant from the delivered image, which is 178 pixels wide; at that width individual digits are not reliably legible. The operator did NOT transcribe these values. This is recorded as a lead to be confirmed, never as an input to any budget calculation, and roll_tokens.status stays PARTIAL until confirmed.

coach_titles.confirmed: The coach chooses one prefix and one suffix. Each gives a percentage increase to the FINAL score in a game when its condition is met, applied to all players. Titles may be changed freely without spending roll tokens.

stats.unresolved: The base coefficients are runtime values ({f:helpstat_N}). They are now populated from S6, a user-supplied reading of the in-client scoring panel, and carry points_status PARTIAL. They may NOT be promoted to CONFIRMED without a direct Tier-1 client read. Nothing here comes from a previous year's table.

points_provenance.what_was_read: All 18 base coefficients plus the Deaths starting credit and the Teamfight Participation maximum, transcribed by the operator from the in-client Fantasy scoring panel as reproduced in a Chinese guide article.
internal_consistency_checks: All 18 values map one-to-one onto the 18 {f:helpstat_N} placeholders in the shipped localization, with no placeholder left unfilled and no value left over.
Each value's FORM matches its template: a per-second rate for Stuns, a capped maximum for Teamfight Participation, a starting credit plus a per-death debit for Deaths, and a bare multiplier for GPM.
The Deaths credit is exactly ten times the per-death debit (1950 = 10 x 195), which is the kind of round relationship a genuine table has and a misreading generally does not.
what_this_does_NOT_establish: the transformation semantics behind a value (see scoring_pipeline.unresolved_semantics)
whether the coefficients differ by role, by period, or by emblem colour
that the panel read was of the live TI2026 client rather than an earlier build
points_provenance.promotion_rule: points_status becomes CONFIRMED only on a direct read of the live client's Fantasy -> How to Play -> Scoring panel, recorded as a Tier-1 source.

rewards.note: DOTA_Fantasy26_RewardTierName0..8 give nine percentile tiers with a Points column filled at runtime. An older non-2026 string block (DOTA_FantasyCraftHelp_RewardsBottom25 .. RewardsTop1) lists 1,000 / 2,500 / 6,000 / 10,000 / 18,000 / 25,000 Compendium Points for six coarser bands; it is NOT assumed to apply to 2026 because 2026 ships its own nine-tier table.

overall_rank_rewards.input: Predictions Score plus Fantasy Score (DOTA_Score2026_Predictions / DOTA_Score2026_Fantasy)

rewards.objective_consequence: Rewards are percentile-banded, not proportional to score. The decision-relevant objective is therefore the probability of clearing a percentile threshold, which is not the same as maximising expected score. Which of the two to optimise cannot be settled until the tier point values are known.

eligibility.rule: Only accounts active when the event began are eligible to play this year's Fantasy and Predictions.

evidence_grades.note: Every fact in this ruleset carries one of four grades. A guide article that reproduces a client panel is NOT Tier-1 by transitivity: it is corroboration by a secondary channel, and it is graded as such.

grades.tier_1_confirmed: established from a Valve-shipped file or an official Valve publication
grades.user_screenshot_corroborated: read by the operator from an in-client panel reproduced in a user-supplied image; consistent with the Tier-1 templates but not itself Tier-1
grades.partial: the structure is established but at least one semantic or numeric component is not
grades.unresolved: not established by any source available in this run
